title: Peroxodisulphuric acid synthesis in a flow electrolyser and its potential utilisation for black mass leaching
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42450-42459
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06474K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aigerim Tazhibayeva, Altynai Tanash, Yaroslav Zhigalenok, Saken Abdimomyn, Seiilbek Malik, Kaiyrgali Zhumadil, Sergey Nechipurenko, Fyodor Malchik
A coaxial flow electrolyser generates peroxodisulfuric acid at 180 g L−1 concentration with 1.5 Wh g−1 energy consumption. Applied to spent battery black mass, the acid extracts lithium quantitatively but shows limited transition metal recovery.
